name: Axioma E-Ink
tagline: Asynchronous Task Router & Ambient Glanceboard for E-Ink Displays
description: A hardware-conscious task routing and ambient glanceboard system designed for electrophoretic (e-ink) displays. Features a zero-JS high-contrast static HTML display view with periodic meta-refresh, a daily Big 3-5 focus task model, append-only event-sourcing for offline reconciliation, and an interactive desktop E-Ink simulator.
ergonomic_goals: Zero-JavaScript E-Ink Display View (GET /display): guaranteed compatibility with Kindle and Kobo basic browsers without battery-draining sockets or script execution.
Hardware-conscious 1-bit typography: ultra-high-contrast monochrome styling with zero animation to eliminate electrophoretic ghosting and flashing.
Daily Big 3-5 Focus Architecture: eliminates decision fatigue by strictly bounding the active board to 3 to 5 high-impact tasks.
Functorial Event Sourcing (L1-002): state is derived from an append-only event stream, enabling clean offline reconciliation when e-ink devices reconnect.
Decoupled Partitioned Persistence (L1-011_3): independent event log and task snapshots ensuring atomic updates.
Interactive E-Ink Hardware Simulator: desktop preview showing exactly how the physical e-reader screen renders in real time.
Embedded Generational Feedback: in-app feedback modal funneling user observations into the G2 learning stream.
